sanitization: Removed 62 nonessential provider request IDs; all model decisions, timings, errors, scores, and outcomes remain.
evidenceContext.sourceRevision: The coordinator verified the deployed scenarios SHA before this smoke run and corroborated that no scenario changes occurred afterward. The browser harness did not independently capture a run-time source SHA.
evidenceContext.browser: Local headless Chromium drove the static UI; API requests traversed an authenticated Jupyter bridge to the live configured Akamai app.
evidenceContext.providerLatency: Provider latency is the remote Akamai app server adapter wall time, including external OpenRouter network, routing, inference, response transfer and validation. Jupyter/browser transport is excluded from provider latency.
evidenceContext.browserLatency: browserRoundTripMs and totalMs include authenticated Jupyter bridge transport and local browser work. They are not public-deployment latency measurements.
evidenceContext.accuracy: Operational checks passed without an accuracy threshold. Luna courier remained incomplete at two of five checkpoints after eighteen decisions; eleven moves scored optimal. That failure is preserved.
evidenceContext.limitations: Small synthetic task sample. Provider order was fixed by this smoke harness; upstream caching was not controlled. Use the separate 72-request frozen benchmark for matched observations and rotating provider order.
